title: Cast duplicates
description: The Cast's duplicate records and what staff did about them (cast/duplicates.json, docs/duplicates.md). validate-cast.js checks the rules a schema cannot: every person is a Cast person with that name, pairs are unique, a decided pair names who decided, and a merged record's Guid is no Cast person's.

pairs.description: Pairs Rock's duplicate finder scores. Each load runs the finder, then writes each pair's decision. A pair that is missing after the finder runs fails the load's Cast expectations.

decision.description: open: nobody has decided, so the Duplicate Finder lists the pair (its confidence must be above the list's 60). not-a-duplicate: a staff member clicked Not Duplicate. ignored: a staff member clicked Ignore, which hides the pair until its score changes.

decidedBy.description: The staff member who decided. Required for not-a-duplicate and ignored.

decided.description: When they decided. Required for not-a-duplicate and ignored.

mergeRequests.description: Merges asked for by someone who cannot merge people. Rock keeps each as a Person Merge Request entity set, listed on the Merge Requests page.

notifyAfterMerge.description: The request's Notify Me When Merged box. Rock emails the requester after the merge.

merges.description: Merges staff already made. The merged record is gone. Rock left its alias on the person, a Merged line in their History, and its last name as a previous name when it differs.

record.description: The record Rock merged into the person and deleted.

person.description: A Cast person, by Guid, with their name for people reading the file.

date.description: A date that counts back from the install day: daysAgo, or yearsAgo with a month and day. The time is optional.
